myapp.Models.checks_n_approvals module¶

This module contains classes used to make checks and approvals. Contains the following classes.

  1. Checks: used for making all checks

  2. Approvals: Used for making all approvals.

class myapp.Models.checks_n_approvals.Checks(mydict, required_inputs=None)[source]¶

Bases: myapp.Helpers.input_validators.ValidInputs

A class used for making checks.

Inherits from the ValidInputs class which is used here to ensure that the inputs provided in mydict are of valid types and names.

Attributes: mydict (dict): A dictionary containing all inputs provided by the user.

required_inputs (list): A list containing the inputs required for a given check.

check_dual_registration()[source]¶

Validates that a user cannot register as an admin and as a client.

If a user is registered as an administratorr, checks if the same user(email adress) is registered as a client. If so, return an error message indicating the case. Otherwise return an sqlalchemy querry object for an administrator or client. If all the tests fail then return unregisterd email.

Parameters

None –

Returns

Dual registration error. sqlalcehmy object (obj): An sqlalcehmy object unregistrered email (str): Unregistered email.

Return type

Error message (str)
